title: Grateful Dead Live at San Antonio Civic Auditorium on 1972-11-26
lineage: SBD> MR> (set 1 ?; set 2 C)> D> CD> EAC>SHN

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording with noticeable hiss and early‑set muddiness, but a stellar second set highlighted by a smoking Dark Star and Feeling Groovy jam.
ai_review.review: The show shines despite its uneven audio – the first half is plagued by hiss, distortion and a brief splice, while the latter portion bursts into life with an inspiring Dark Star, a soaring Feeling‑Groovy improvisation, and tight performances of Jack Straw, Brokedown Palace and Big River. Reviewers consistently praise the band’s energy and Phil Lesh’s prominent bass, even as they lament the rough early sound.

ai_rating.rationale: Average star rating ~3.9 across 12 reviews; strong positive comments on musical performance offset by recurring complaints about early‑set audio quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Early tracks suffer from hiss, distortion and a noticeable splice at ~20:08; later songs clean up with decent balance. Overall soundboard but not a pristine master.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set is musically solid but marred by poor audio; the second set lifts the show with seamless transitions and high‑energy jams.

band_member_comments.Phil: Phil Lesh's bass is prominent and powerful, especially noted in the later portion of the show.
